correctedFindings.finding: roles.adjudicationProvider is only the domain provider entrypoint; the provider call must execute one admission-guarded physical dispatch. The function explicitly throws AWARENESS_CREATION_UNACCOUNTED_PROVIDER when guard.run was not entered exactly once.
correctedFindings.effect: Simply assigning MockLlmProvider as adjudicationProvider cannot make creation pass: MockLlmProvider.prepareBattleEncounter computes locally and never enters the guard.

correctedFindings.finding: repository saveSheet is no longer a V2 creation/import route; V2 historical seed data belongs to backend/src/testing/historical-character-fixtures.ts.
correctedFindings.effect: The E2E's management-only V2 fixtures should use saveHistoricalCharacterFixture, while keeping the 409 rejection assertions.

governingSources.why: New awareness battles bind immutable policy and record every physical attempt, including unknown usage; no automatic fallback/retry or paid run is authorized.
New ordinary battles bind awareness-v5-usage-v2 through creation, manifest/runtime, dispatch, and provider request; historical policies remain unchanged and no migration/paid call is included.
awareness-v5 is new-battle-only with immutable policy/prompt/output/asset snapshots; role ports are typed and the orchestrator has no SDK/DB dependency.
V2 historical fixtures use testing-only modules; saveSheet requires a V3 target.
The actual admission guard validates route/limits, reserves one creation attempt, increments sends, invokes the physical callback, and requires sends === 1.

connection_options.name: typed_test_provider_with_guarded_dispatch
interface_contract: Attach AwarenessProviderRoles to an E2E-local provider object, but implement adjudicationProvider.prepareBattleEncounter so it obtains currentAwarenessDispatchContext() and calls guard.run exactly once.

Build the AwarenessPricedRequest using the same provider/model, limits, rendered system/user material, output cap, deadline, response format, and request label expected by the actual awareness adjudication path; do not invent a relaxed request shape.

Inside guard.run's send callback, invoke the deterministic Mock domain computation and return { result: BattleEncounterProposal, usage: null }. This preserves observed admission, reservation, physical completion, and the sends === 1 check without network or SDK calls.

Use typed AwarenessModelProvider subconscious/conscious functions that return schema-valid deterministic outputs; use typed AwarenessNarrationProvider methods whose frozen results preserve battleId, turnReceiptId, phase, turn, source speeches, and recognition references.

Keep identities route-shaped for the current contracts (adjudication xai/grok engine; latent openai/gpt-6-luna; conscious xai/grok engine; narration xai/grok fast) while the test implementation remains local and deterministic.
verification: Creation records one observed attempt and reaches ready.
No Mock.prepareBattleEncounter call occurs outside the guard callback.
V5 runtime and narration worker receive the same bound policy and immutable assets.

connection_options.name: real_provider_adapter_with_limited_fakewire
interface_contract: Use the existing provider adapter/awareness JSON transport and intercept only its loopback wire response; preserve the real adapter's currentAwarenessDispatchContext handling, one physical request, response validation, attempt accounting, and observed reservation.
Return deterministic schema-valid encounter, latent, conscious, adjudication, and frozen narration payloads from the loopback fakewire; make no external or paid call.
connection_options.tradeoff: Covers more serialization/adapter behavior but adds a transport surface to this browser E2E. It is unnecessary if typed role-port coverage is the intended acceptance boundary.

assertions_to_preserve: Real loopback browser and API path with ordinary authenticated user creation.
Immutable V3 generation IDs/digests remain bound after later authoring revisions.
advance, advance/stream, and action each retain idempotent replay and unchanged battle revision/assets.
Battle completes, ordered frozen narration is published, result survives reload, and no page errors occur.
Cutover deletes unfinished battle, all deleted routes return 404, late narration acknowledges, and finished history remains visible.
required_current_assertions: Change the stale manifest check at line 144 to schemaVersion 5 and assert awareness-v5, bound policy, prompt revision, output revision, and immutable asset IDs/digests.
Use createLlmNarrationGenerator only as the existing dispatcher after llm.awareness.narration is installed; do not let V5 narration fall back to legacy Mock narration.
non_goals_and_unknowns: Do not restore old production normal creation, remove the E2E, migrate existing battles, or alter accepted ADRs.
Do not make the SDK itself an acceptance requirement for this offline browser E2E; typed role doubles are allowed by the owner design, while the real app/API remains exercised.
Exact helper placement and deterministic prose are owner implementation choices; they do not create new product requirements.
No remote/provider, paid, deployment, Seal, or test execution was performed.
